card.title: Xbox Wireless Controller "We can't sign you in right now. Try again later." error when signing into Xbox/Xbox Accessories App Repair

source.title: Xbox Wireless Controller "We can't sign you in right now. Try again later." error when signing into Xbox/Xbox Accessories App Repair

symptoms: 'We can't sign you in right now' in Xbox Accessories app

claims.statement: The Xbox Accessories app sign-in error is fixed by installing Xbox Identity Provider (Microsoft Store product 9WZDNCRD1HKW), which can only be opened via its direct store link.

procedure: Open ms-windows-store://pdp/?ProductId=9WZDNCRD1HKW and install Xbox Identity Provider.
card.caveats: Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
